rule.text: For each election, each pollster's last poll (latest fieldwork end, then latest publication, then later row) whose fieldwork ended in the 3 days before polling day or on it, started before polling day, and was published on or before polling day (a blank Published cell does not count); a party's average is the equal-weight mean over the pollsters reporting it. Results are PollBase's Result rows (GB vote shares). Shares as published, UK-basis polls included.
